messages.text: wait. hold on. that test just failed again.

ugh. which one is it? the election timeout race?
yeah. timing dependent. sometimes the new leader's first heartbeat lands before the old one finishes committing its last entry. so we get a gap in the log index sequence on the follower.
hmm. that one's a pain to repro since it depends on actual wall clock timing.
ok ok ok, I'm gonna inject a deterministic fake clock into the test harness now. no more "works on my machine" energy.
please do. I hate when we have to rerun a suite 10 times to see if it's actually broken or just being dramatic.
give me 5 mins to wire it up properly. once it's in, we can force the exact interleaving that triggers the bug every single time. also I'm naming the fake clock `time_is_a_lie`. feels appropriate.
